credentials: PHD  Univ of California Los Angeles
name: Thierry Laurens

ratings.comment: This is one of the best teachers I have ever had. There is no excuse to do poorly. He gives you every resource you need to do well and really cares that his students understand whats going on in the lecture. I wish he was teaching my future math classes!!!
Very nice during office hours and easy to discuss with. Would definitely take him again if I could.
Best math teacher ever, I wish he could teach all my math classes

Math 211 was not an option but was what I took, great professor, explains things very well, no trig, much easier than AP calc, 2 midterms and 1 final make up the grade with weekly homework and discussion quizzes only worth 2% of your grade.

Real Analysis has a degree of infamy as a course for math students. Laurens spends the time building strong foundations, showcasing examples, and some of the more "complicated" topics end up feeling like natural extensions of topics you are already comfortable with. If you have the chance to take a course with Professor Laurens, I recommend it.

I made an account just to talk about how awesome this professor was. I did not need to read the book a single time. Lectures were very clear and very concise. Homework problems felt like discovering theorems yourself, and prepares you very well for exams. Answers questions perfectly. I only got a B because I didn't review my notes, purely my fault.

One of the best math professors I've had, very clear about content and expectations, good explanations,  the book that he references (its available as pdf) is also very helpful. Also a very kind and understanding guy.
Amazing professor, one of the best in the math department. Lectures were very clear, professor responded often and in-depth on piazza. Exams were easy if you understood the homework.

Thierry knew his stuff for this class. As a mechanical engineering student this was a pretty interesting class. The first 2/3 of the course was very doable and Thierry made it easy to understand. The last 1/3 was much more conceptually challenging but Thierry made the test like the homework's so it wasn't the worst. He is also responsive on piazza.

Managed to make ODEs fun. Fantastic lecturer, very clear explanations and checks for questions often. Homework load is reasonable and the content on the assignments follows directly from the stuff covered in class. Great hair too.

Good lecturer who is responsive to questions on Piazza. The course if challenging if you're new to proofs, but he made it a pleasant experience overall. Be aware that practice exams are useful for gauging the length of the real exams, but not the content. He replaces your lowest midterm grade with the final if it helps you, which is nice.

I took him for Math 415 (not listed on rate my professor) and he was great! By far the best lecturer I've had in the UW math dept; with no real experience in ODEs, he made the subject both interesting and easy to digest for me. His grading and lectures were very student friendly and followed the textbook closely, which made studying a lot easier.

My favorite professor I've had. His lecturing is very clear and well-spoken, no accent, he's young but is VERY knowledgeable. I often email and went to office HRs, he always sent extremely helpful responses and takes time to help you if needed. Highly recommend, I'm not great at proofs but his teaching got me a solid B in such a difficult course.

Great honor to have him at his first class at UW-Madison!  It shows he spends a lot of time crafting his lectures and responding to students in great details.  Treats us with a lot of respect and will go out of his way to make sure you understand why the answer is the way it is.

Has clear lectures that are well organized. He always asks if there are any questions and office hours are a must! His piazza answers are very detailed, often much more so than you expect. He cares a lot about his students and wants to give any resources that help them succeed. The tests are closely based on the homework and are fair.
